The\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsturdiness of the brooms helps\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tit find usage in the industrial\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tsector as\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\twell as household usage.\r\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t
